entities.summary: Mikiyo Tsuda  is the pen name of Mikiyo Tsuda, a Japanese manga artist active since 1998. Under the name Taishi Zaō , she writes boys love and girls love manga while under Mikiyo Tsuda she writes comedy-shōjo manga.
